description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the Pim plugin module. It manages the pre-render setup of the employee list component, including permissions checks for delete actions based on user roles, and sets up a Vue.js component with relevant properties.

classes.name: EmployeeController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling the employee list view, including permission checks and component setup within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the employee list component for rendering, setting properties and permissions based on user roles and workflow states.
